tagline.zh: Android 上的 Markdown 编辑器：Flutter 做壳，Milkdown 做内核
tagline.en: A Markdown editor for Android: Flutter shell, Milkdown core

desc.zh: Android 上的 Markdown 编辑器：Flutter 做壳，Milkdown 在 WebView 里做编辑内核，文档走 SAF，支持导出 DOCX、HTML 和 PDF。
desc.en: Mdeditor is a Markdown editor for Android: a Flutter shell, a Milkdown core in a WebView, SAF documents, and DOCX, HTML and PDF export.

desc.zh: Android 上的 Markdown 编辑器：Flutter 做壳，Milkdown 在 WebView 里做编辑内核，文档走 SAF，支持导出 DOCX、HTML 和 PDF。
desc.en: Mdeditor is a Markdown editor for Android: a Flutter shell, a Milkdown core in a WebView, SAF documents, and DOCX, HTML and PDF export.

summary.zh: 在 Android 上做 Markdown 编辑器，纯 Flutter 路线意味着自己实现富文本的光标定位、选区和输入法合成，每件都是独立工程。我把编辑内核换成跑在 WebView 里的 Milkdown，Flutter 留下文件、设置、主题和导出。文档走 Android SAF，打开、编辑、保存始终指向同一个 URI。
summary.en: Building a Markdown editor on Android, the all-Flutter route means hand-writing caret positioning, selection and IME composition — three separate projects on their own. I moved the editing core into Milkdown inside a WebView and left Flutter with files, settings, theme and export. Documents go through Android SAF, so open, edit and save keep pointing at the same URI.

zh.title: 编辑内核不自己写
zh.body: Milkdown 基于 ProseMirror，解析层是 remark，标题、列表、表格、代码块在输入时就成形，不需要再开一个预览窗。

zh.title: 代码块是一等公民
zh.body: 语法高亮随主题切换重建，带行号、折叠和一键复制；导出 DOCX 时高亮按 token 保留。

zh.title: 手写 OOXML 导出
zh.body: document.xml、样式、编号、页眉页脚、目录和媒体关系自己写，不用动辄几十兆的跨平台文档库。

zh.title: SAF 让文件待在原地
zh.body: 取到 URI 后调用 takePersistableUriPermission，重启应用接着写，不会多出一份拷贝。

zh.title: 一条桥，一个协议
zh.body: Flutter 和 WebView 只通过 MdBridge 说话，消息统一是 {type, ...} 的 JSON，目前只有 ready 和 changed 两种。

zh.title: 开源可下载
zh.body: GitHub Actions 为每个版本自动打包 APK，GPL-3.0，README 有中英日法四份。

en.title: I did not write the editing core
en.body: Milkdown sits on ProseMirror with remark underneath, so headings, lists, tables and code blocks take shape as you type instead of in a preview pane next to a text box.

en.title: Code blocks are first-class
en.body: Highlighting rebuilds when the theme switches, with line numbers, folding and one-tap copy; in the DOCX export the tokens survive.

en.title: Hand-rolled OOXML
en.body: document.xml, styles, numbering, headers and footers, the table of contents and the media relationships are written by hand instead of pulling in a cross-platform document library that runs to tens of megabytes.

en.title: SAF keeps the file where it is
en.body: Once the URI is picked up, takePersistableUriPermission holds the grant, so the app reopens on the same document after a restart and no stray copy appears in storage.

en.title: One bridge, one protocol
en.body: Flutter and the WebView only speak through MdBridge. Every message is JSON shaped {type, ...}, and there are exactly two kinds: ready and changed.

en.title: Open source and installable
en.body: GitHub Actions packages the APK for every release, GPL-3.0, with a README in Chinese, English, Japanese and French.

label.zh: 博文：把 Milkdown 塞进 WebView

tagline.zh: 把意图编译成可验收、可追溯的执行链
tagline.en: Compiling intent into chains you can accept and audit

desc.zh: LLM 之上的确定性运行时：意图编译成带验收标准的 Plan DAG，副作用过审批闸门，回执进哈希链审计日志。
desc.en: Intent OS is a deterministic runtime above the LLM: intent compiles into a Plan DAG, side effects pass an approval gate, receipts are hash-chained.

desc.zh: LLM 之上的确定性运行时：意图编译成带验收标准的 Plan DAG，副作用过审批闸门，回执进哈希链审计日志。
desc.en: Intent OS is a deterministic runtime above the LLM: intent compiles into a Plan DAG, side effects pass an approval gate, receipts are hash-chained.

summary.zh: 它不是 agent，也不是又一个 agent 框架，而是跑在 LLM 之上的确定性一层。意图先编译成带验收标准的 Plan DAG，有副作用的节点要过审批闸门，每次执行写一条哈希链回执。底下换成哪个 agent，这一层不动。
summary.en: Not an agent, and not another agent framework — a deterministic layer above the LLM. Intent compiles into a Plan DAG whose nodes carry acceptance criteria, side effects pass an approval gate, and every run leaves a hash-chained receipt. Swap the agent underneath; this layer stays.

zh.title: 计划节点自带验收标准
zh.body: exit_code、file_exists、file_contains 三种判据，判定的是事实而不是模型的自我感觉，失败时能打印它看到了什么。

zh.title: 两道审批，不是一道
zh.body: 计划级审批问的是这件事该不该做，副作用级审批问的是这次调用、这组参数此刻能不能做。

zh.title: 回执进哈希链
zh.body: 每条记录带 prev_hash 和 hash，改动任意一条，后续所有哈希就对不上；无密钥用 SHA256，有密钥用 HMAC-SHA256。

zh.title: 失败可以改道，也可以挂起
zh.body: 验收没过就换一条执行路径，都耗尽了就把现场封成任务文件，等人接手再恢复。

zh.title: LLM 在下面，人在上面
zh.body: 规则引擎还没写：沙箱内写入自动放行、越界的问人，是下一步。当前审批还是命令行问答。

en.title: Every node carries its own acceptance criteria
en.body: exit_code, file_exists and file_contains decide on facts rather than the model's opinion of itself, and a failure can print what it actually saw.

en.title: Two gates, not one
en.body: The plan gate asks whether this is a reasonable thing to do at all; the side-effect gate asks whether this call, with these arguments, is acceptable right now.

en.title: Receipts go into a hash chain
en.body: Every record carries prev_hash and hash, so changing one of them leaves every later hash mismatched. SHA256 without a key, HMAC-SHA256 with one.

en.title: Failure reroutes, or suspends
en.body: A failed acceptance picks another executor; when the alternatives run out, the scene is sealed into a task file and waits for a human to pick it up.

en.title: The LLM sits underneath, the human on top
en.body: The rules engine is still to come: auto-approve sandbox writes, ask about anything outside. Today the approval is a question on the command line.

label.zh: 博文：为什么我不做 Agent 框架
label.en: Essay: Why a Runtime, Not Another Agent Framework

tagline.zh: 终端里的本地代码助手，裁决权不在模型手上
tagline.en: A local coding assistant in your terminal, with the verdict taken off the model

desc.zh: 终端里的本地 Ollama 编程助手：3B 模型只提议，写完必验、重复强停、路径越界拒绝，全程离线。
desc.en: Local Ollama Harness is a terminal coding assistant: a 3B model proposes, the harness verifies, repeats are stopped and paths are sandboxed.

desc.zh: 终端里的本地 Ollama 编程助手：3B 模型只提议，写完必验、重复强停、路径越界拒绝，全程离线。
desc.en: Local Ollama Harness is a terminal coding assistant: a 3B model proposes, the harness verifies, repeats are stopped and paths are sandboxed.

summary.zh: 用一句自然语言让它在 sandbox 里创建、修改并运行 Python 文件。模型只连本机 Ollama，默认 qwen2.5-coder:3b，全程离线。3B 模型靠不住，所以裁决权交给 harness：写完必验、验证后收尾、重复动作强停、路径越界直接拒绝。
summary.en: Create, edit and run Python files inside a sandbox from a plain-language prompt. It talks only to a local Ollama (qwen2.5-coder:3b by default), so it works offline. A 3B model is not dependable, so the harness keeps the verdict: verify after writing, finish after verifying, hard-stop on repeats, refuse any path outside the sandbox.

zh.title: 模型只提议，harness 裁决
zh.body: 图里有三个节点：model、guard、act。每一步要做什么，guard 说了算，模型只是给出提议。

zh.title: 每种失败模式都有对应规则
zh.body: 写完不验、验完不收尾、重复同一个动作、整轮吐空字符串、格式写坏——五种毛病各有一条确定性规则兜着。

zh.title: 四个工具共用一个出口
zh.body: read_file、write_file、list_dir、run_python 都走 safe_path，展开 ../ 和符号链接后判定包含关系，越界就拒绝。

zh.title: 干预是一架梯子
zh.body: 先提醒，再给一份能照抄的模板，还不行就替它跑一遍，最后才强停；每一级背后都有计数器，不会永远转下去。

zh.title: 测试不下载模型
zh.body: FakeLLM 按剧本回放输出，六个用例覆盖全部失败模式，不用 GPU，跑完不到一秒。

en.title: The model proposes, the harness disposes
en.body: The graph has three nodes: model, guard and act. What may happen this turn is the guard's call, not the model's.

en.title: Every failure mode has a rule
en.body: Writing without verifying, verifying without finishing, repeating the same action, answering with an empty string, breaking the output format — five failure modes, five deterministic rules.

en.title: One exit for all four tools
en.body: read_file, write_file, list_dir and run_python share a single safe_path that resolves ../ and symlinks before testing containment, and refuses anything outside.

en.title: Intervention is a ladder
en.body: Remind first, then hand over something it can copy, then run the command on its behalf, and only then stop the turn. Every rung has a counter, so none of them can loop forever.

en.title: Tests without a model download
en.body: A FakeLLM replays scripted output and six cases cover every failure mode. No GPU, and the whole suite finishes in under a second.

label.zh: 博文：不信 3B 模型，把守卫写成代码
label.en: Essay: Distrust the 3B Model, Encode the Guard

tagline.zh: 只给一个不太可信的模型造笼子
tagline.en: A cage for one model I don't fully trust

desc.zh: 只锁 MiniMax 一个模型的 Claude Code hook：项目外删改硬拒绝，不常见下载问人，灰区交给独立审计模型。
desc.en: MiniMax Lockdown is a Claude Code hook for one untrusted model: hard denies outside the project, prompts on uncommon downloads, audits the gray zone.

desc.zh: 只锁 MiniMax 一个模型的 Claude Code hook：项目外删改硬拒绝，不常见下载问人，灰区交给独立审计模型。
desc.en: MiniMax Lockdown is a Claude Code hook for one untrusted model: hard denies outside the project, prompts on uncommon downloads, audits the gray zone.

summary.zh: 一组 Claude Code 的 PreToolUse / PostToolUse hook，只在当前模型是 MiniMax 时才启动：rm、mv、改注册表、碰 ~/.ssh 和 ~/.aws 一律硬拒绝；git clone、wget 这类不常见下载弹窗问人；剩下的灰区交给独立审计模型，它回 verdict、confidence 和 severity。别的模型一律 exit 0，零开销。
summary.en: A pair of Claude Code PreToolUse / PostToolUse hooks that only engage when the active model is MiniMax. rm, mv, registry edits and anything touching ~/.ssh or ~/.aws are hard-denied; uncommon downloads like git clone or wget raise a prompt; the gray zone goes to a separate auditor model that answers with a verdict, a confidence and a severity. Any other model exits 0 at once.

zh.title: 机械层：命中就拒绝
zh.body: rm、rmdir、mv、带 ~ 的写命令、reg add / setx / regedit，以及 .ssh、.aws、.claude/projects 等敏感路径，直接 deny，不解释也不商量。

zh.title: 问人层：只问不常见的
zh.body: git clone、wget、Invoke-WebRequest 这类操作弹窗给人看，机械层不替人猜这个下载该不该做。

zh.title: 审计层：灰区交给模型
zh.body: curl、npm install、pip install 这些走独立审计模型，prompt 里带上合法的工具链目录和临时目录，让它有事实可判。

zh.title: 置信度路由，少弹窗
zh.body: 审计结果带 confidence，超过阈值直接放行或直接拒绝，只有拿不准的时候才打扰人。

zh.title: 会话备忘，同一件事只问一次
zh.body: 批过的操作按签名记进 approved，PostToolUse 那半边还能事后补记；机械层的硬拒绝永远不进备忘。

en.title: Mechanical layer: deny on a match
en.body: rm, rmdir, mv, write commands carrying a ~ path, reg add / setx / regedit, and sensitive paths like .ssh, .aws or .claude/projects are denied outright, with no explanation and nothing to negotiate.

en.title: Human layer: only the uncommon
en.body: git clone, wget and Invoke-WebRequest raise a prompt. The mechanical layer refuses to guess whether a download should be allowed.

en.title: Auditor layer: the gray zone goes to a model
en.body: curl, npm install and pip install reach a separate auditor model, and the prompt hands it the legitimate toolchain roots and the temp directories so it has facts to judge on.

en.title: Confidence routing, fewer popups
en.body: The verdict carries a confidence value. Past the threshold the hook decides on its own; only the uncertain middle reaches you.

en.title: Session memo, one question per action
en.body: Approved actions are remembered by signature, and the PostToolUse half can add them after the fact. A mechanical hard deny never enters the memo.

label.zh: 博文：给不太可信的模型造笼子
label.en: Essay: A Cage for One Untrusted Model

tagline.zh: 给 agent 用的 OCR 工具服务
tagline.en: OCR as an MCP service for agents

desc.zh: 基于 PaddleOCR 的 MCP 服务：文字、表格、手写、公式四种识别，公式输出 LaTeX，中英日韩多语言。
desc.en: OCR MCP is a PaddleOCR-backed MCP server: text, table, handwriting and formula recognition, with LaTeX output and Chinese, English, Japanese and Korean.

desc.zh: 基于 PaddleOCR 的 MCP 服务：文字、表格、手写、公式四种识别，公式输出 LaTeX，中英日韩多语言。
desc.en: OCR MCP is a PaddleOCR-backed MCP server: text, table, handwriting and formula recognition, with LaTeX output and Chinese, English, Japanese and Korean.

summary.zh: 基于 PaddleOCR 的 MCP stdio server，四件工具：文字、表格、手写、公式。公式直接输出 LaTeX，表格输出结构化文本，中英日韩都能认，默认中文。输入收本地路径和 HTTP(S) URL，pip install 之后就能挂进 Claude Desktop。
summary.en: A PaddleOCR-backed MCP server on stdio with four tools: text, tables, handwriting and formulas. Formulas come back as LaTeX, tables as structured text, and it reads Chinese, English, Japanese and Korean with Chinese as the default. Inputs are local paths or HTTP(S) URLs, and one pip install plugs it into Claude Desktop.

zh.title: 四件工具
zh.body: 文字识别、表格识别、手写识别、公式识别，各走各的接口，不做一锅端的万能 OCR。

zh.title: 公式直接给 LaTeX
zh.body: 识别出来的是能贴进 Markdown 的源码，不是图片，也不只是一串读不出来的字符。

zh.title: 表格是结构化文本
zh.body: 行列关系被保留下来，下游可以直接解析，不需要再做一次视觉还原。

zh.title: 本地路径或 URL 都收
zh.body: 输入既可以是磁盘上的文件，也可以是 HTTP(S) 地址，远程截图不用先落盘。

en.title: Four tools
en.body: Text, table, handwriting and formula recognition, each behind its own tool, instead of one do-everything OCR endpoint.

en.title: Formulas come out as LaTeX
en.body: You get source you can paste into Markdown, not an image and not a string of unreadable characters.

en.title: Tables come out structured
en.body: Rows and columns survive the recognition, so downstream code can parse the result instead of rebuilding the layout by eye.

en.title: Local paths and URLs both work
en.body: The input can be a file on disk or an HTTP(S) address, so a remote screenshot does not have to be downloaded first.

tagline.zh: 纯批处理实现的 JDK 切换器
tagline.en: A JDK switcher written in pure batch

desc.zh: Windows 上的纯批处理 JDK 切换器：java.bat 垫片转发到选中的 JDK，JAVA_HOME 不写死，附只读 MCP server。
desc.en: JEnv for Windows is a pure-batch JDK switcher: a java.bat shim forwards to the JDK you pick, and JAVA_HOME never points at a hard-coded path.

summary.zh: 一个 java.bat 垫片挡在 PATH 前面，把它转发到你选中的 JDK。同一终端里两个项目可以跑在两套 JDK 上。JAVA_HOME 永远指向 JEnv 目录，jenv use 和 jenv local 立刻对读环境变量的工具生效。附带一个只读 MCP server，让 agent 也能查当前 JDK。
summary.en: A java.bat shim sits in front of java on PATH and forwards it to the JDK you picked, so two projects in one terminal can run on two JDKs. JAVA_HOME always points at the JEnv directory, which means jenv use and jenv local take effect immediately for tools that read the environment. A read-only MCP server lets an agent ask which JDK is active.

zh.title: 不依赖 PowerShell
zh.body: 纯 cmd 和 batch 实现，拷进任何一台 Windows 机器就能用，不挑 shell。

zh.title: JAVA_HOME 不再写死
zh.body: 它恒指向 JEnv 目录本身，真实 JDK 路径从注册表文件里读，改版本不用动环境变量。

zh.title: 配置是三份纯文本
zh.body: 三个注册表文件替掉一份 JSON，diff 得出来，也手改得动。

zh.title: agent 也能查
zh.body: 附带只读 MCP server，暴露当前 JDK 和已注册版本，只读，不给它改的机会。

en.title: No PowerShell dependency
en.body: Pure cmd and batch. Copy the folder onto any Windows machine and it works, without caring which shell you have.

en.title: JAVA_HOME stops being hard-coded
en.body: It always points at the JEnv directory itself while the real JDK paths come from registry files, so switching versions never means editing environment variables.

en.title: Configuration is three plain files
en.body: Three registry files replace one JSON config: it diffs cleanly and you can still edit it by hand.

en.title: An agent can ask too
en.body: A read-only MCP server exposes the active JDK and the registered versions. Read-only, by design.

tagline.en: The site you are looking at

desc.zh: 零依赖的手写静态站：原生 HTML、CSS 与 ES module，Python 脚本构建，Windows XP 桌面，关掉 JS 也能读。
desc.en: This site is a hand-written static site: native HTML, CSS and ES modules, built by a dependency-free Python script, with a Windows XP desktop.

summary.zh: 手写的静态站：原生 HTML、CSS 和 ES module，一个零依赖的 Python 脚本组装，没有框架、没有 CDN、没有网络字体。桌面是 Windows XP，每个窗口是一个 IE6，但页面在构建期就渲染好了，关掉 JavaScript 也能读完。
summary.en: A hand-written static site: native HTML, CSS and ES modules, assembled by a dependency-free Python script. No framework, no CDN, no web fonts. The desktop is Windows XP and every window is an IE6 shell, but the pages are rendered at build time, so the whole thing still reads with JavaScript switched off.

zh.title: 零依赖，零构建
zh.body: 没有 npm，没有打包器。tools/build.py 只用 Python 标准库，把 pages 和 data 里的内容组装成静态文件。

zh.title: 图标是手绘像素画
zh.body: 每个图标都是 16×16 的像素图，写死在 tools/xp_icons.py 里，不用图标字体也不用 CDN。

zh.title: 窗口里是真的浏览器外壳
zh.body: 地址栏能输入、前进后退会置灰、菜单能下拉、对话框能弹，Windows XP 的部分是真做了的。

zh.title: 中英并存于一份 HTML
zh.body: 两套语言写进同一份产物，靠 html[lang] 切换，不做两份页面，也不用路由。

zh.title: Soul for U 原地未动
zh.body: 那个写给一个人的小房间原样留在 /soul-for-u/，只是搬到了隔壁。

en.title: Zero dependencies, zero build
en.body: No npm, no bundler. tools/build.py uses nothing but the Python standard library to assemble pages and data into static files.

en.title: The icons are hand-drawn pixels
en.body: Every icon is a 16×16 pixel drawing defined in tools/xp_icons.py. No icon font, no CDN.

en.title: The windows are real browser chrome
en.body: The address bar takes input, Back and Forward grey out when there is no history, the menus drop down and the dialogs behave. Parts of Windows XP are actually implemented.

en.title: Two languages in one HTML file
en.body: Both languages ship in the same output and switch on html[lang]. No second page, no router.

en.title: Soul for U left alone
en.body: That small room written for one person stays exactly where it was at /soul-for-u/ — it only moved next door.

tagline.zh: 四篇关于代理、运行时和守卫的笔记
tagline.en: Four notes on agents, runtimes and guards

summary.zh: 代码之外的记录：一个 3B 模型为什么靠不住、一层 runtime 能做什么、一个混血编辑器的代价，以及怎么给不太可信的模型造个笼子。半夜想通的事，先写下来。
summary.en: Notes that sit next to the code: why a 3B model cannot be trusted, what a runtime layer actually buys, what a hybrid editor costs, and how to put a cage around a model you do not fully trust. The things that clicked at 3 a.m., written down.

tagline.en: A page written for one person

summary.zh: 一个只为某个人存在的小房间：星光、一段信、几句悄悄话，配着能循环很久的音乐。它没有被改版，只是搬到了隔壁。
summary.en: A small room that exists for exactly one person: starlight, a letter, a few whispers, and music that loops for a long time. It wasn't redesigned — it just moved next door.
